name.ja: アルカナフォース<ruby>Ⅷ<rt>エイト</rt></ruby>－<ruby>ＳＴＲＥＮＧＴＨ<rt>ストレングス</rt></ruby>

text.en:
If this card is in your hand and a card that has a coin tossing effect is on the field: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Arcana Force VIII - The Strength" once per turn. If this card is Summoned: Toss a coin.
● Heads: Take control of 1 monster your opponent controls.
● Tails: Your opponent takes control of 1 other monster you control.
